name: M3_CRS420MI_Complete
description: Change the status of an existing application message to **Completed** (status 50) and record when the action was finished. The operation updates the message’s completed date; if no completed date is supplied, the current date is stored. Use this to mark that the action requested in the message has been handled, so follow-up lists and integrations can distinguish completed messages from those still requiring attention.

inputParameters.name: MLID
inputParameters.description: Unique mail ID of the application message to mark as completed.

inputParameters.name: CDAT
inputParameters.description: Completion date to set for the application message; if left blank, the current date is used.
